Repaired (fixture was not a shimmer): now a top-level for loop alternating l between list and int; tclsh 8.6.18, 9.0.4, 9.1.0 show list int list int. The repaired test fails on a product fault: the same conversion fires S100 in straight code and inside `while {1} {…; break}` (as S100, not S101), and nothing inside a `for` body. Diagnosed: inside the for body the captured read representation (walk ResolveContext::contents_representation_at) is unknown, though the shimmer replay state is [List] after lindex; cost_at_read relies on the capture. Routed to analyser-binding

The braced amount `incr value {$step}` must stay a BracedLiteral word (it raises in tclsh: expected integer but got "$step"); the retained word is not that literal. Diagnosed 18 Nov: after the first incr value $step, the next increments lower as unproved Calls plus caller-frame-opaque barriers with no retained statement. Routed to analyser-binding

Cites retained-representation-metadata: `incr {é(}` reads the cell named é( literally; only $value is recorded. Diagnosed 18 Nov: from set é 9 on, each command lowers as an unproved Call plus a caller-frame-opaque barrier, so incr {é(} is never an Incr. Routed to analyser-binding

tclsh: the arms bind x with different types and the merge read converts; `switch -- $v` in a procedure records no merge. Probe (tcl8.6): a top-level `switch -glob -- $mode {…}` lowers to Call switch plus a <caller-frame-opaque> barrier "switch upvar-aliases a dynamic caller variable"; inside a procedure the same switch lowers structurally. Routed to analyser-binding
tclsh: `lappend acc $x; set acc "$acc,"` alternates list and string forms each iteration; the loop body's quoted word gets no layout
tclsh: an int-seeded variable alternating numeric and string use in a loop re-converts every iteration; nothing reported in the procedure
